name: sfu_lane_map_ref-m1-COMMIT
purpose: Required native control adapter for CLOSED SFU lane index5. Four registered edges, native controller must bind and measure their phase/cost; not full quarter qualification. All new data/PG M5. Shape is pin-bound: N1200bits/103.68um=11.57, W546/49.68=10.99.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_sfu_lane_map u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay_ring.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/ot_hgi_sfu_lane_map.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/sfu_lane_map_ref/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/sfu_lane_map_ref/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/sfu_lane_map_ref --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_sfu_lane_map  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: Actual CLOSED SFU source hardcodes lane5. Per-instance mapper preserves arithmetic view and changes only lane-dependent loaded offsets, indices and lin mask; four explicit registered edges and ring-delayed passthrough. Source-dependent exact/mutant proof, no lane RTL reroute.
